top_signals.title: ‘Resilience or reliance’ – Tech chiefs urge Burnham to spend £20bn on ‘sovereign AI’
top_signals.summary: British tech bosses have called on the government to commit more than £20bn to sovereign AI infrastructure, warning the UK risks becoming dependent on foreign technology in one of the most important industries of the coming decades.
